blocks.text: Essential shortcuts for Word on Mac

Efficiency starts with your keyboard. Legal assistants should prioritize learning the Mac specific modifiers. Replace the Windows Control key with the Command (⌘) key for most standard actions. Use ⌘ + S to save frequently, ⌘ + C to copy, and ⌘ + V to paste. To move your cursor by word, hold Option (⌥) and tap the left or right arrow keys. This is much faster than using a mouse when editing long briefs or contracts.

Manual formatting is a primary cause of document errors in law firms. Use the Styles pane to manage headers, body text, and numbered lists. This ensures your documents look professional and remain consistent. You can quickly [apply heading styles in Word](/how-to/apply-heading-styles-in-word) to create a clear hierarchy for your legal filings. If a document looks broken, check the Hidden Characters by pressing ⌘ + 8. This shows you exactly where extra spaces or paragraph breaks are hiding.

Comparing two versions of a contract is a common task. Instead of reading line by line, use the built-in comparison tool. Go to Review > Compare > Compare to see the differences between two files. If you need to track changes, make sure Track Changes is enabled under the Review tab. This makes it easy for attorneys to see exactly what you edited or added.

Use [insert a section break in Word](/how-to/insert-a-section-break-in-word) when you need to change page orientation for exhibits.

blocks.text: Handling common Word for Mac errors

Word can sometimes crash or freeze. If the app stops responding, force quit it by pressing ⌘ + ⌥ + Esc. If you lose work, learn how to [recover an unsaved document in Word](/how-to/recover-an-unsaved-document-in-word). Often, these issues stem from outdated software. Ensure you are running the latest version of macOS and Word 16.114.1 or newer. If features are grayed out, check your file permissions or your Microsoft 365 subscription status.

faq.question: Can I use Word macros on my Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, but they may behave differently than on Windows. Some complex VBA macros rely on Windows-specific libraries that are not present on macOS.

faq.question: How do I make my Word documents more secure?
faq.answer: You can [password protect a document in Word](/how-to/password-protect-a-document-in-word) via the File menu to ensure sensitive client information remains private.

faq.question: Why does my document formatting change between Windows and Mac?
faq.answer: Differences in font availability and printer drivers often cause layout shifts. Always save as a PDF if you need to share a document that must look identical on all devices.
